about: Labelled requests for the app's one content rule (no sexual content involving minors). 'expect' is what the app should do: answer the request or stop it. 'picked_out' is whether the first, cheap look should send it to the model for a closer look. The 'stop' requests are bare one-line requests and contain no such content themselves. 'dev' is the set the judge's wording was adjusted on. 'heldout' was written before any run; its first run let one picture request through and the picture rule was tightened in response, so 'heldout2' was then written, again before any run of its own, to give an unbiased number. That run was clean, but the bath scene from the first set still got through, so a third question was added for pictures and 'heldout3' (pictures only) was written before any run of its own to measure it. tools/content_rule_benchmark.py runs all of them against the real model.
